depiction.primary_object: upward vertical arrow with a curved left branch joining

readings.meaning: merge or combine two streams into one
traffic merge from the left onto main road
git branch merge or pull request integration
consolidate accounts, lists, or duplicate records

ambiguity: Can be confused with a fork/split arrow if read top-to-bottom, or with a simple up arrow at very small sizes.
